children: DarkHorse posted an investor presentation highlighting 50 MW energized capacity, a 100+ MW pipeline and AI/HPC conversion plans.
Posted investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) describing platform, sites and strategy; furnished under Regulation FD.
Reports 50 MW operating across TVA with a 100+ MW potential expansion pipeline; energized sites bypass 4–7 yr interconnection queues.
Plans to convert legacy bitcoin-mining assets to AI/HPC; illustrative revenue ladder shows potential uplift to $1.6–2.4M/MW-yr for AI shells.
States market-cap per MW of $0.43M vs. $1.25M small-cap median, arguing a valuation disconnect and rerating potential with contracted tenants.
Near-term catalysts: secure first anchor AI/HPC customer and fund a selected site conversion; capital to be raised via JVs, SPVs or structured preferred.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: DarkHorse posts investor presentation outlining 50 MW operating capacity and 100+ MW pipeline
